spans.s: DG0321 स्निग्ध snigdha Slimy/unctuous/oily; one of the 20 gurvadi gunas; caused due activated Jala mahābhūta; denotes physiological & pharmacological sliminess; manifested by moistening of body parts, increased strength and lustier; pacifies vata, increases kapha.
AF2102 स्निग्ध दर्शनं snigdha darśanaṁ Sees objects in unctuous
AF2103 स्निग्ध वर्ण snigdha varṇa Oily colored
SV0266 स्निग्ध- अश्नियात् snigdha- aśniyāt Eating unctuous food gets digested quickly, taste well, stimulates the unstimulated digestive fire, and alleviates Vata and Pitta.

SV0267 स्निग्धाअन उपाचरेत् snigdhāana upācaret Unctuous food treatment- person who are vata prakriti, dryness in the body, exhausted by copulation, who indulge in excess physical activities should be treated with unctuous food.
